description: Most recent, most frequent, highest spend.
recommended_actions: VIP/early-access programme; loyalty rewards; referral incentives; avoid blanket discounts.

description: Previously frequent, high spend, but have gone quiet.
recommended_actions: Priority win-back: personal outreach, offers on previously bought categories, feedback survey.

description: Bought recently but with few orders so far.

description: Long inactive with low order count.
